result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now works as the same command as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. The `cli` module tests pass. I didn't run the command end to end, so I haven't confirmed that `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` creates `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` and `index.html`.

- **`Commands.java`:** I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE = "analyzeLandscape"` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is now listed in the no-argument usage overview, next to `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`:** The dispatch accepts either name and runs the same method. `-help` prints the usage for whichever name you typed. `updateLandscape -help` still prints its own usage.
- **`README.md`:** It had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section covering `init`, `generateReports`, `analyzeLandscape`, `updateLandscape` and `updateConfig`. It notes that `updateLandscape` is the same command, kept for existing scripts.
